plugin.split.hint: Click a box to select it · <kbd>Shift</kbd>+click = multi-select · drag = move · bottom-right corner = size · edges = crop · <kbd>←↑→↓</kbd> = 1 px (bypasses snapping), <kbd>Shift</kbd> = 10 px.
plugin.split.border_note: Bevel relief comes from the light source (global, below): without it, a bevel is just a gradient.
plugin.split.free_only: Only active with “Free” aspect: with the aspect kept, the box keeps its source format and a single size is enough.
plugin.split.shadow_off: Enable the drop shadow (switch above) to edit these values.
plugin.split.rot_over: Rotation is OVER BUDGET in this format (1080p50): ~31.9 ms/frame for a 20 ms budget — the engine will drop below the target fps. Keep it for 720p, or lower the frame rate.
plugin.split.rot_tight: Rotation is MARGINAL at 1080p25 (~31.9 ms for a 40 ms budget = 80 %): no headroom, and over budget during a transition.
plugin.split.rot_ok: Rotation is comfortable in this format (~11.4 ms/frame at 720p, 4 boxes).
plugin.split.rot_live_over: The engine is currently over the frame budget and
plugin.split.rot_live_over2: box(es) are rotated: set rotation back to 0 to recover the frame rate.
plugin.split.art_pending: Image imported — enable the artwork to bake it.
plugin.split.art_need_img: Import an artwork image first: without an image, keying has no object.
plugin.split.art_note: Imported image (PNG/JPEG), not a 6th video input: live video artwork would cost 21.7 ms/frame at 1080p (108 % of the 50 fps budget). A transparent PNG with the “alpha” key is the cleanest case. The image is not persisted: re-import it after a container redeploy.
plugin.split.look_note: The light gives bevelled borders their relief — a single light lits the whole scene (four inconsistent lights = a fake set). The stagger makes boxes arrive one after another; it is counted WITHIN the requested duration.
plugin.split.budget_na: Engine metrics unavailable (:8080) — is the container running?
plugin.split.budget_ok_t: Per-frame compositing cost against the frame-rate budget (100 % = drop-out).
plugin.split.budget_warn_t: Compositing is approaching the frame budget — no headroom left for another effect.
plugin.split.budget_over_t: Compositing exceeds the frame budget: the Split drops below its target fps. Rotation is by far the heaviest item — removing it is the first move.
plugin.split.mem_note: Recall uses the curve and stagger set in “Light & transitions”.
plugin.split.stale_engine: The engine deployed on this container does not publish its transition settings (script older than the 0.9.0 contract): the values above are the manifest defaults, not the live state. Redeploy the container to remove the ambiguity.
plugin.split.snap_title: Snaps the box to the frame edges and center, and to the other boxes. The arrow keys bypass snapping (pixel-accurate placement).
plugin.split.knob_title: Vertical drag, mouse wheel, arrow keys (Shift = fine step). Double-click = default value.
plugin.split.multi_delta: Multi-selection: the value you type is applied as an OFFSET (the change requested on the reference box is carried over to each box, which keeps its own layout).
plugin.split.mixed_knob: Multiple values in the selection. Acting on this control applies it to ALL selected boxes (uniformise).
plugin.split.mixed_color: Different colours in the selection: picking one uniformises them.
plugin.split.mixed_toggle: Different states in the selection: toggling applies the same state to ALL selected boxes.
plugin.split.box_enable_one: Show this box (per-box setting, never applied to the selection).
plugin.split.box_src_one: Source of this box (per-box setting, never applied to the selection).
plugin.split.multi_note: Any setting changed below applies to ALL selected boxes. Position, size and z-order are carried over as an OFFSET (each box keeps its relative layout); appearance (crop, rotation, opacity, border, shadow…) is UNIFORMISED. A “≠” marks diverging values: as long as you don't touch that control, it is not overwritten. Source and activation stay per-box (“Boxes & background” column).
